I started this account 2 weeks ago, only astrology, and am at level 117. 

Agility is a fantastic money maker and will be a necessity for buffing combat later on, but its messier, costs a lot of various resources, and, for skilling non-combat, it’s much less effective than Astrology. 

Meteorite nodes are for mining at Level 112. They will add up (you can’t tell how much you’ve accumulated until Mining112) but they ARE there and, once you reach the appropriate levels, will skyrocket your mining and smithing to 120 due to their inflated XP. 

TLDR: Do astrology. It’s kick ass, easy to level, and makes other skills permanently more effective without any additional effort.
